# Repositories mint-deploy-token.yml may write a Cloudflare credential into.
#
# One owner/name per line. Blank lines and #comments are ignored.
#
# This is a file rather than a dashboard variable on purpose: who may
# receive a live credential is exactly the kind of change that should
# appear in a diff and have a reviewer. A variable changes with no trace.
#
# Absent or empty means NOBODY. The workflow fails closed — an open
# default fails silently and totally, a closed one fails once, clearly,
# the first time somebody uses it.
#
# The allowlist is the second lock. The first is the GitHub App
# installation: the run fails unless the app can see the target and write
# its secrets, so a repository nobody installed the app on cannot be
# provisioned however this file reads. This stops a request file in THIS
# tree from redirecting a credential to another repo the app also reaches.

raineydavid/nationalff
raineydavid/screening
raineydavid/ontold
